scene_description: The image shows a multi-lane highway with a large number of vehicles stopped or moving slowly in heavy traffic. In the upper left quadrant, a large white semi-truck is positioned in a line of smaller cars and trucks. The roadway is divided by a concrete median barrier. In the lower right section, several cars are visible, including a dark SUV in the foreground and a white sedan further back. The background consists of a dense forest of green trees. The lighting suggests daylight conditions, and the perspective is from an elevated position overlooking the highway.<turn|>
editing_instruction: Add several orange and white emergency response vehicles, including a fire truck and an ambulance, positioned in the breakdown lane and weaving through the traffic. Place a group of rescue personnel in high-visibility neon vests and helmets standing near the white semi-truck, coordinating the scene. Add a portable emergency lighting tower near the center of the highway. Place orange traffic cones and reflective pylons to delineate a rescue corridor. Ensure all added vehicles and personnel are scaled realistically to the highway and maintain the existing daylight lighting and elevated perspective.<turn|>
